answer: Because the oasis index resolves every citation against the terrace checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the falcon audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. A farm of 2556 identities would post 629 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
